keyFindings: All 259 in-scope candidates have a final legal status and candidate-specific handler/state/backend traces; none is complete or unverified.
The fail-closed disposition is 212 incomplete actions, 34 obsolete non-actions, and 13 duplicate callback/composition candidates bound to canonical controls.
Crop/transform geometry tests do not prove pointerup emits exactly one authoritative edit command.
Dropdown, View/TitleBar menus, and Export/Settings dialogs lack complete keyboard focus movement and return-focus behavior.
Keyframe lane, diamonds, and menu divs lack complete keyboard focus/navigation and direct exact-command interaction tests.
MediaPanel AI generation is a permanently disabled visible placeholder because generate_* remains a stub.
MediaPanel view-mode, sort, and filter buttons are visible HoverButtons with no onClick handler.
Most Inspector and timeline fire-and-forget edit branches do not render backend rejection or recovery.
Preview scrub is an unnamed non-focusable div rather than a keyboard-operable slider.
ScrubbableNumberField display mode remains pointer-only without role, name, tabIndex, or keyboard adjustment, affecting many Inspector numeric fields.
Semantic search hides search-index start failures and query rejection has no user-visible error path.
SplitPane is pointer-only; media/search/recent cards also have keyboard reachability gaps.
Track mute/hide/sync-lock role=button spans lack tabIndex, Enter/Space handling, and aria-pressed state.
